referenceFunction.generalComment: This study adresses Swiss dams only. The data have been applied for an extrapolation to preliminary describe dam-mixes in non-alpine countries. Considering the difficulty to clearly seperate within the Swiss dams system for some of the dams function for normal electricity generation from pumping storage, the same basic information has been used for the modules describing the two functions. A representative sample of Swiss dams with a height of more than 30 metres is taken into account for calculating the numbers. Lifetime is assumed to be 150 years. The efficiency of the pumps is assumed to be 70%. The results of this module cannot be applied to describe a single unit.; UUID: 4f96fd19-e24d-3747-8d23-d3db976337ab
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Includes the conversion of electricity from domestic high voltage grid to potential energy by pumping water up to the reservoir and generation of peak-load power when water flows back down to the turbine (reverse mode). The module has the same structure as the module for operation for reservoir plants.

technology.text: The module describes average installed technology with an efficiency of 70% (best technology has 74%).

representativeness.uncertaintyAdjustments: Data may not be representative for specific national conditions. The uncertainities calculated for the Swiss conditions have been somewhat increased.
